Reference

Fantomon ability trees

Every page of every Fantomon's ability tree, drawn the way the game lays it out, with what it costs to fill the page and what a full page grants. There are three trees, one per Fantomon role, and each later generation of Fantomon gets the same tree with a bonus on every node.

How it works

A tree has ten pages; page one has 19 nodes and the rest 34, and each node has ten levels. A node at level N grants its whole row for that level (CalculatePetAbilityProps adds the full level_prop_pet_ability row), so an ATK node also carries small HP, DEF and SPD amounts and, from level 5, a percent bonus. The headline stat is what the node shows. Costs come from pet_ability_prop and are the same for every node on a page; each role pays in its own material family. Pages open in order, and some need a promotion: page 2 at Expert I, page 4 at Champion I, page 6 at Master I, page 8 at Paragon I, page 9 at Saint I. Second-generation Fantomon get +10% on every node's stats and third-generation +20%, from pet_ability_prop_scale_factor.

Roles and who uses each tree: DPS (Falko), Tank (Boaro), Support (Mandragora, Chomusuke).
